test_title: PYST 48: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 82% of the registered voters cast their vote and 4% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 60% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 1968 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let the total number of voters be 100 units.

⇒ Votes cast = 82% of 100 = 82 units

⇒ Invalid votes = 4% of 82 = 3.28 units

⇒ Valid votes = 82 − 3.28 = 78.72 units

Winner gets 60% of valid votes = 60% of 78.72 = 47.232 units

Loser gets 40% of valid votes = 40% of 78.72 = 31.488 units

Majority = 47.232 − 31.488 = 15.744 units

According to question:

15.744 units = 1968

⇒ 1 unit = 1968 ÷ 15.744 = 125

⇒ 100 units = 125 × 100 = 12,500

**∴ The number of registered voters is 12,500.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of registered voters be X.

⇒ Votes cast = 82% of X = 0.82X

⇒ Invalid votes = 4% of 0.82X = 0.0328X

⇒ Valid votes = 0.82X − 0.0328X = 0.7872X

Winner gets 60% and loser gets 40% of valid votes.

⇒ Majority = 20% of valid votes

⇒ 0.20 × (0.7872X) = 1968

⇒ 0.15744X = 1968

⇒ X = 1968 ÷ 0.15744

⇒ X = 12,500

**∴ The number of registered voters is 12,500.**
